mapper.select: select province_name as provinceName, group_concat(area_name separator '、') as areaName from ins_province_area group by province_code

select
big_area_code as bigAreaSaleCode, big_area_sale as bigAreaSale, small_area_code as smallAreaSaleCode, samll_area_sale as smallAreaSale from sta_dealership_data_view where big_area_sale is not null
and brand = #{brandName}
group by big_area_code, bigAreaSale, small_area_code, smallAreaSale order by bigAreaSaleCode desc

select city_code as areaCode,city_name as areaName, province_code as provinceCode, province_name as provinceName, big_area_code as bigAreaSaleCode, big_area_sale as bigAreaSale, small_area_code as smallAreaSaleCode, samll_area_sale as smallAreaSale from sta_dealership_data_view where big_area_sale is not null group by areaCode,areaName,provinceCode,provinceName,big_area_code, bigAreaSale, small_area_code, smallAreaSale order by bigAreaSaleCode desc
